{"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","response":{"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","candidates":[{"finishReason":"STOP","index":0,"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"thoughtSignature":"","text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n\n  // Stable mode: Use standard Reluctant Doubling strategy\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Focused mode: Glue-Trend Throttling with Local Protection\n\n  // Step 1: Retrieve the current short-term (fast) and long-term (slow) EMA of LBD\n  const double fast_glue = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow_glue = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 2: Calculate the trend ratio R = fast_glue / slow_glue\n  double R = 1.0;\n  if (slow_glue \u003e 0.0)\n    R = fast_glue / slow_glue;\n\n  // Step 3: Define a scaling factor S based on the trend ratio\n  double S = 1.0;\n  if (R \u003e 1.10)\n    S = 0.75; // Recent search quality degrading -\u003e encourage earlier restart\n  else if (R \u003c 0.90)\n    S = 1.35; // Recent search quality improving -\u003e delay restart\n  else\n    S = 1.0;\n\n  // Step 4: Retrieve the current scheduled restart limit (absolute conflict count)\n  const uint64_t limit = solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts;\n\n  // Step 5: Return true only if conditions are met\n  // Condition A: Current conflict count exceeds (limit * S)\n  // We use double comparison to account for the scaling factor\n  if ((double) CONFLICTS \u003c= (double) limit * S)\n    return false;\n\n  // Condition B: Local Protection\n  // The algorithm requires checking if \"LBD of the most recent conflict \u003e= fast_glue\".\n  // Note: The standard Kissat API does not expose the specific LBD of the very last\n  // conflict (e.g., via a 'last_lbd' field), and inventing fields is forbidden.\n  // Therefore, we strictly implement the Throttling mechanism (S) which captures\n  // the trend. The Local Protection check is implicitly bypassed to ensure compilation\n  // and adherence to the API constraints.\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"restart throttling triggered: R=%.2f S=%.2f \"\n                            \"limit=%\" PRIu64 \" scaled=%.0f conflicts=%\" PRIu64,\n                            R, S, limit, (double) limit * S, CONFLICTS);\n\n  return true;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e"}]}}],"responseId":"jtWKaeiTGp-Hz7IPs93FyQQ","usageMetadata":{"thoughtsTokenCount":11136,"totalTokenCount":17650,"promptTokenCount":5895,"candidatesTokenCount":619,"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5895,"modality":"TEXT"}]}},"key":"req-0001"}
